title: Motion design built on the Atelier, not as a separate editor
summary: A composition is an Atelier screen plus a declarative motion@1 timeline; a Web Animations runtime plays it; the agent edits data, never animation code; export runs in headless Chrome. Lottie, audio and an easing-curve editor were left out of scope.

title: Video export with WebCodecs, mediabunny and gifenc; ffmpeg dropped
summary: Spike showed headless Chrome encodes H.264, VP9, VP8 and AV1 at 1080p, so ffmpeg adds nothing. mediabunny 1.65.2 (MP4, WebM) and gifenc 1.0.3 (GIF) are pinned; MP4 is offered only when the browser can encode it.

title: motion@1 format, validator and timeline store
summary: Pure validator (allowed props, safe values, easing, increasing key times, orphan tracks as warnings), atomic store with a revision check and GET/PUT routes.

title: Timeline runtime inside the prototype iframe
summary: Frame-exact seek, play, pause, load and loop through Web Animations; screens without a timeline render unchanged. Verified in real Chrome.

title: Agent tools to create and adjust animations
summary: Three Atelier tools plus a 200-token timeline summary in the agent context. A probe with 3 real free models gave 11 valid timelines out of 12 on the first try and 12 of 12 after one correction.

title: Motion player in the Atelier
summary: Motion button and transport bar (play, loop, scrub with keyframe marks, keyboard), open state saved. Built from the approved prototype and checked in the real Atelier.

title: Video export in WebM, MP4 and GIF
summary: Export dialog, job queue (one per project, cancel, 10-minute limit, files removed after 24 h) and endpoints. A 10-second 1080p 30 fps animation exports in about 46 seconds (MP4) and 48 seconds (WebM); the goal was under 2 minutes.

title: Keyframe panel with editable timeline
summary: Lanes per layer, keyframe drag with frame and key snapping, inspector for values and easing, keyboard, two-way layer selection; edits join the Atelier history so Ctrl+Z works. Dragging with 50 tracks ran at 59.9 fps.

title: Saving a timeline and cancelling an export never worked through the real server
summary: ui/server.js answered 405 to every PUT and DELETE outside the Canvas API, so 24.01 and 24.05 shipped with two routes that failed in real use. The tests called the router directly and missed the gate. Found while testing 24.06 in the real Atelier; fixed there, and the end-to-end tests now start the real server.

title: Atelier header clipped its buttons with the chat open
summary: With the chat open on a 1500 px window the preview column is about 592 px and Canvas, Iniciar, Motion, Exportar and Recarregar were unreachable. The header now wraps to a second row. The test failed before the fix with five clipped buttons.

title: Prototypes approved and EP-24 accepted after testing in the Atelier
summary: The user approved the player, export dialog and keyframe panel prototypes before implementation and accepted the epic (6 of 6 stories) after testing in their own Atelier. Index now counts 147 of 185 deliveries.

title: Full suite at the close of EP-24
summary: Complete test suite after the header fix; one unrelated SQLite migration test failed once under load and passed alone three times.

title: Wrong diagnosis of the engine host collision, corrected by reproducing it
summary: We first said the main checkout had started using a worktree's host code and advised npm run host:stop. Reproduced on a test port: a host from another checkout has another token, so the main chat only gets a token error, and host:stop run in the main prints 'stop requested' while the host stays alive. Story 23.07 was written from the verified behavior.

title: Implement story 23.07 (engine host per checkout)
summary: Per-checkout port, token-free /identity and a stop that tells the truth are specified but not built.

title: Pure Mermaid diagram model
summary: Type detection, validation with source line and expected tokens, sanitized render, SVG/PNG/.mmd/Markdown exports, payload and API client. Only validate.ts and render.ts import mermaid. The shared Canvas client base was extracted and the 49 board tests stayed green.

title: Mermaid needs a DOM to parse and counts error lines after its own cleanup
summary: mermaid.parse fails in plain Node (DOMPurify.addHook), so validation is tested with the real library in Chrome. Mermaid reports an error on line 6 as line 3 after dropping front matter, comments, directives and the blank lines before them; lineMap.ts maps it back. One case stays approximate: a trailing %% comment joins the next line.

title: Full suite with the diagram model
summary: Complete test suite measured in the 21.03 worktree before merging.

title: Index shows 0 deliveries for EP-17 and EP-23 while 7 stories are on main
summary: Code of 17.01, 17.02 and 23.01 to 23.05 is merged but the index counts 0 of 13 and 0 of 6. 23.02 to 23.04 have all criteria checked; 23.05 lacks a browser check of the reconnect banner; 17.02 lacks the UI to merge the two PRD chats; 17.01 and 23.01 still say planned with no criteria checked.

title: Executive log plus fact sheet for the executive report
summary: Outcomes, decisions, corrections, approvals and pending items are logged as they happen with evidence; a command builds a fact sheet from the log, git, stories and dossiers, and the report cites only that sheet.
